items.title: Raymond James bullish on Schwab amid ‘compelling valuation’
items.summary: Investing.com -- Raymond James upgraded Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) to Strong Buy with a $135 price target in a note on Wednesday, telling investors that the brokerage is a clear winner from interest rates staying higher for longer.

items.title: Applied Optoelectronics Sinks 9% on $550 Million Stock Sale Plan; Coherent and Lumentum Rise 4%
items.summary: Record revenue, a blockbuster hyperscale deal, and still the market flinched. Applied Optoelectronics keeps returning to investors for cash, and while rival optics names climb, one CFO comment hints at why this funding pattern has traders on edge.
